about.en: Kimberly-Clark Corporation is a US consumer products company listed on Nasdaq that makes diapers, training pants, baby wipes, feminine and incontinence care products, tissue, towels and professional hygiene supplies under brands including Huggies, Kleenex, Scott, Kotex, Cottonelle, Pull-Ups, Poise, Depend and WypAll. In tokenized and derivative markets, KMB is the reference equity for products tracking Kimberly-Clark shares.
